dct_title_s: Roumanie-Hongrie : Cracovie - Galicie - Bukovine - Bessarabie - Dobroudja - Transylvanie - Serbie - Sofia
dct_description_sm: Relief shown by hachures and spot heights.
Shows railroads, roads, waterways, marsh/swampland, fortification lines, cities and towns.
Includes more towns than other 1916 edition, possibly dating this map to 1917.
Mounted on linen, originally folded, cover missing.
